scope: Independent observed tool-start rounds bound to their actual preceding model request. Membership requires the model result's action count and matching tool ends. Mixed delegation rounds, incomplete or ambiguous identities remain explicit. Client ready-to-submit and server ingress/queue-to-service use separate local clocks; their timestamps are never subtracted across clocks or summed into end-to-end delay. Served latency distributions are conditional; unknown and still-unserved rounds remain. Logical Host-hit tokens are not physical H2D bytes or a prefetch oracle.
